11426-hybrid-distributed-memory-parallel.summary: This algorithm balances load by classifying cells as small or large, using object-order sampling for small cells and image-order sampling for large cells to ensure scalability on unstructured grids.

9054-gpu-asynchronous-streaming.md.name: GPU Asynchronous Streaming

9634-transform-feedback-gpgpu.md.name: Transform Feedback GPGPU
9634-transform-feedback-gpgpu.md.summary: Transform Feedback GPGPU maps computations to vertex and geometry shaders, using stream-out to record data directly into buffers for flexible multiple outputs without fragment shaders.

11538-megakernel-generation.md.name: Megakernel Generation
11538-megakernel-generation.md.summary: Megakernel generation consolidates rendering integrands into a single GPU kernel, minimizing memory bandwidth by storing state in registers rather than using inter-kernel communication.

10234-warp-subgroup-level-primitives.md.summary: Warp/Subgroup Level Primitives enable direct communication and aggregation among threads within a single GPU execution unit (warp, wavefront, or subgroup) using registers and fast on-chip logic, bypassing global memory latency. 3683-subgroup-operations.md.name: Subgroup Operations
3683-subgroup-operations.md.summary: Subgroup operations are fast, hardware-synchronized collective computations within a warp or wave that exchange data via registers, avoiding the latency of global memory synchronization used by atomic operations.

4949-warp-shuffling.md.summary: Warp Shuffling is a warp-level reduction technique using hardware shuffle instructions to keep data in registers, eliminating shared memory allocation and synchronization barriers.

10224-warp-level-reduction.md.name: Warp-level Reduction
10224-warp-level-reduction.md.summary: Warp-level reduction aggregates update requests within a GPU warp to minimize redundant global atomic operations, distinguishing itself by focusing on contention reduction for atomic primitives.

12357-adaptive-atomic-reduction-arc.md.name: Adaptive Atomic ReduCtion (ARC)
12357-adaptive-atomic-reduction-arc.md.summary: Adaptive Atomic ReduCtion is a GPU primitive that accelerates differentiable rendering by performing warp-level reduction in registers and dynamically distributing remaining atomic traffic to reduce L2 cache pressure.
